title: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) Wireless Earbuds with USB-C Charging, Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency Mode, Personalized Spatial Audio
bullets: Up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation, plus Adaptive Audio that blends ANC and Transparency.
USB-C charging case with precision Find My speaker and lanyard loop; up to 30 hours total listening with the case.
Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking for theater-like sound on Apple TV+, Music, and compatible apps.
Touch control for playback, calls, and ANC modes; sweat and water resistant (IP54) earbuds and case.
Conversation Awareness lowers media volume when you start speaking to someone nearby.
Seamless pairing across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch with automatic device switching.
Includes four silicone tip sizes (XS, S, M, L) for a better seal and noise isolation.
description: AirPods Pro 2 pair Apple's H2 chip with redesigned drivers for stronger noise cancellation and clearer call quality in wind.
Adaptive Audio responds to your environment — quieter on the train, more ambient awareness when you walk city streets.
The USB-C case charges from the same cable as recent iPhone models and supports MagSafe and Apple Watch chargers.

aplus.heading: From the manufacturer
paragraphs: Apple designs AirPods firmware and the H2 chip together for features like Adaptive Audio that rely on on-device machine learning.
Hearing Test and Hearing Aid features (availability varies by region) expand Pro 2 beyond music and calls.

reviews.author: Megan B.
reviews.title: Daily driver for commute + gym
reviews.body: ANC on the subway is excellent and they stay put during runs. USB-C case finally matches my iPhone cable.

reviews.author: Luis G.
reviews.title: Spatial Audio is immersive
reviews.body: Watching movies on the iPad with head tracking feels close to a mini theater. Transparency mode sounds natural.

reviews.author: Hannah J.
reviews.title: Great earbuds, tips take experimentation
reviews.body: Stock M tips leaked sound for me. XS sealed better and ANC improved immediately. Do the fit test in Settings.

reviews.author: Owen C.
reviews.title: Android pairing is basic
reviews.body: They work as Bluetooth headphones on Pixel but you lose seamless switching and Precise Find My. Fine if you are in Apple ecosystem.

qa.question: Do these work with MagSafe chargers?
qa.answer: Yes. The USB-C AirPods Pro 2 case supports MagSafe and Qi wireless chargers in addition to USB-C.

qa.question: Is the Lightning version different sonically?
qa.answer: No. Audio and ANC are the same; the case connector is the main difference.
